messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@curelytics.io>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: SIG kickoff & short intake

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — appreciate you walking us through Curelytics' ingestion pipeline and the goals for the pilot. As discussed, next step on our side is to begin the vendor security questionnaire (SIG) so your security team can review controls and we can map evidence to the asks.

Quick asks to get started:
- Can you confirm whether Curelytics will consider the pilot to involve PHI (HIPAA scope) or strictly de-identified data?
- Data residency: where will customer data be stored (AWS regions / account ids)?
- Target timeline: when would your security team like the initial questionnaire returned?

I've attached a short SIG prefill (Curelytics_SIG_prefill.xlsx) with the model-level details we already collect and a high-level network diagram (redwood-network-diagram-2027.pdf). If you prefer, we can share the questionnaire via a secure Drive link or our compliance portal.

I'd like to propose a 30-minute handoff with your security lead next week to walk through the evidence map — would Tue 2/23 10am PT or Wed 2/24 11am PT work?

If you prefer to delegate the intake to someone on your team, please CC them here and we'll route the prefill there.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Curelytics_SIG_prefill.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-network-diagram-2027.pdf (pdf)

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@curelytics.io>

Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SIG kickoff & short intake

Kimberly —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments. Quick answers up front:
- HIPAA: The pilot will process PHI-level records (we're connecting to live scheduling + claims test data).
- Residency: primary storage is in us-east-1; we can provide the AWS account IDs for any evidence that references account-level configuration.
- Timeline: our security team would like the questionnaire returned within 7 business days if possible.

I'll loop in our security lead (security@curelytics.io) — they'll own the SIG review. They asked for the following clarifications before we dive in:
  1) Which SIG baseline are you using (SIGLite / SIG v4.2 / custom)?
  2) Do you have a preferred format for evidence (PDFs, spreadsheet mapping, AWS console screenshots)?
  3) Any special redaction rules for customer data in screenshots?

We can do Tue 2/23 10am PT for the handoff; that works for our team.

—Olivia
Head of Partnerships | Curelytics
olivia@curelytics.io

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for confirming — noted that the pilot will include PHI. Per Markus' notes, a couple of clarifying items before the handoff tomorrow:

1) SIG baseline: we'll plan to send SIG v4.2 as the default. If your security team prefers SIGLite for speed, we can compress the package.
2) Evidence format: we prefer a single mapping spreadsheet (question_id -> evidence file name) plus PDFs/screenshots for the artifacts. For anything that contains customer identifiers please redact or provide sanitized console exports.
3) AWS account IDs / region details: please paste the account numbers in the Drive doc (linked below) or send them to security@redwood.com.
4) Access contacts: please confirm the name/email of the person on your side who will own evidence collection during the 7-day window.

Shared Drive link for the SIG sheet and sample mapping: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cprefill

We'll run the 30-minute handoff Tue 2/23 10:00am PT. Agenda: 1) confirm baseline + scope (HIPAA controls), 2) evidence map walkthrough, 3) timeline & next steps. I'll drop the sample evidence map into the shared Drive now and Markus will join the call.

If anything changes on your side, tell us and we'll adjust. Looking forward to the handoff.

Best,
